metadata_temporality.interpretation: Metadata is a retrospective feature from the current export. Enriched embedding input explicitly sets rating=None; no rating label is placed in the enriched text. Current metadata timestamps postdate many historical reads, so this replay is not a proof of causal availability at read time.

replay.ranker: current afterword_engine.ranking.rank_candidates called directly; strict earlier UTC-day history, all same-day targets held out; source_weight=1 and no catalog-confidence field (read-like neutral default); enriched descriptions/subjects removed from query scoring fields so the tested change is embedding vectors only.

all_identity_linked_rated_targets_unveri.history_enrichment_mode: replace only verified/linked earlier-read vectors that exist; fresh title+author fallback for the rest

replay.limitation: Strict verified results require OpenLibrary metadata, both catalog title/author acceptance gates, and stable-ID or exact-title/author read-candidate join; one conservative suffix-only link is excluded. Target/history enriched vectors exist only for read links with available content; other prior-history reads use the fresh title+author vector in the target-plus-available-history view. It is not a fully enriched 1,777-read history. The original enriched NPZ carries row IDs and shape but no per-row input content hashes; array/file hashes and exact-generating code lineage are verified, while semantic vector-to-text replay is not cryptographically provable from that NPZ alone.

validation.model: same 10 features and ridge 0.1; refit on all strictly earlier causal examples for each calendar day; pooled ranking uses posterior expected ratings on a common 1–5 scale, not daily latent scores; not included in primary variant selection

test.model: same 10 features and ridge 0.1; refit on all strictly earlier causal examples for each calendar day; pooled ranking uses posterior expected ratings on a common 1–5 scale, not daily latent scores; held-out outcomes become training data only after their day

paired_book_bootstrap.bootstrap_unit: individual held-out books; temporal dependence is not captured

calibration_limitation: Ordinal calibration mapping is fitted on in-sample model predictions. Later MAE does not use later labels in fitting, but causal out-of-fold calibration is needed for robust comparative claims.
